answer.text: A floor where buyers step in
A price zone where selling pressure tends to stop price advances

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 53 identifies resistance as the selling-interest level where prices are likely to retract once they approach an established resistance. The Trap: Support is the buying-interest floor; the other options do not match the technical-analysis definition. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A page 53.
